title: test_kb_mcp's HOOK_SHELLS takes System32's WSL bash.exe for a hook shell, so the submit_feedback hook test fails outside Git Bash
goal: From PowerShell or cmd with only Git\cmd on PATH, shutil.which('bash') finds C:\Windows\System32\bash.exe, the WSL launcher, which with no distribution installed prints a UTF-16 notice and exits 1; HOOK_SHELLS counts it as a hook shell and TestPluginManifest::test_submit_feedback_blocked_on_every_docs_server fails. Claude Code on Windows runs shell-form hooks with Git Bash or PowerShell, never WSL's bash, so HOOK_SHELLS leaves System32's bash.exe out (or probes it) and the test passes there. Found by BG-2j5ba56h's full stripped-PATH run on the project host (the clean-account run did not hit it).

run: import os,subprocess,sys; env=dict(os.environ); env['PATH']=os.pathsep.join(p for p in env['PATH'].split(os.pathsep) if not {'usr','mingw64'} & set(p.replace(chr(92),'/').lower().split('/'))); sys.exit(subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/tests.py','-k','test_submit_feedback_blocked_on_every_docs_server'],env=env).returncode)
